12:70.text: So when he had furnished them with their supplies, he put the
bowl into the bag of his brother. Then an announcer called out, "O caravan, indeed you are thieves."

12:71.text: They said while approaching them, "What is it you are missing?"

12:72.text: They said, "We are missing the measure of the king. And for he who produces it is
a camel's load, and I am responsible for it."

12:73.text: They said, "By Allāh, you have certainly known that we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we have not been thieves."
